choice: seed verdict_heads_floor whenever it holds no row, not only when verdict_heads was missing
why: an old-process DB and the deployed DB keep verdict_heads with an empty floor; Repro B and the existing-table mode fail before and pass after

choice: seed COALESCE(MAX(rowid), 0) so a fresh DB stores floor 0
why: the legacy branch then never applies on a fresh DB, so a second start cannot sweep rows handled by current code under the floor; the plan's HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 left that open

choice: one non-verdict outcome classifier replaces the ready-only one; strings shared with verdict paths stay counted
why: a missed shared string would drop a real verdict and stall recovery, which is worse than the split fix f-2 describes

choice: keep it as a test that skips when eb2b606 is absent
why: CI checks out shallow; the existing-table mode covers the same history in CI

choice: a hidden legacy handled row answers a review only when it is a review job's registered handoff; the outcome classifier is deleted
why: outcome strings cannot tell a builder's stuck state=blocked from a BLOCKED verdict (both woke-grok-blocked) and the denylist missed rejected-unregistered-ready; production counts a verdict only once it is registered, so registration is the fact to read

decision: recovery tests that hid an unregistered verdict
choice: finish the review job with that verdict's id
why: production's registration gate never lets an unregistered verdict act, so those tests modelled an impossible state

choice: a hidden legacy row answers a review only when it is a registered review handoff and its outcome is not one only the questions handler writes
why: review jobs may post kind=questions as their handoff, so registration alone cannot tell a questions handoff from a verdict; the questions outcomes (no-questions, waiting-max, already-waiting-max, rejected-questions-author, failed-questions-*) are written only by the questions path, while builder stuck and BLOCKED stay separated by registration

choice: merge main (#423), whose legacy-row check reads only the latest review job's own handoff id; drop the round-3 registered EXISTS and keep main's questions-outcome filter; add the reviewer's job-bound stuck-question retry reproduction for both upgrade modes
why: a retry always makes a new review job, so a ticket-stuck questions handoff of the earlier attempt is never the handoff the binding reads; widening the outcome filter to every rejected outcome would also stop a hidden stale verdict from answering its own review, which main keeps

choice: seed the verdict floor when verdict_heads is new or the floor table is empty
why: an empty floor covers both a newly created table (main's floor_existed check) and a database an older build left empty
